founders.name: Rishit Choudhary
founders.line: Questioning what we lose when we outsource our thinking.
bio: ## Hi! I am Rishit Choudhary
### Who I Am

I am an expert in human cognition and AI. This interesting symbiosis of man and machine has taught me interesting things about cognition. I have not just learnt about thinking, but have fallen into the much deeper and philosophical abyss of what it means to "think". What it means to be "conscious". What it means to be "human".
### The Core Question

I began my studies with focus on regular human cognition. How we think, how our brains develop, etc. But I slowly became more interested in how AI works. After all, it is intelligence that we have created. As I saw a growth in people using AI and integrating it deeply into their daily lives, I asked myself one question. When does it stop being "using a tool" and become "outsourcing our thinking"? This one question led me to conduct research into the impacts of AI on the human mind, combining my expertise in cognition with my interest in AI.
### What I Write About

During my research into the impacts of AI on the human mind, I unearthed a plethora of surprising results. While AI seems to be increasing our efficiency, it actually significantly impacts our critical thinking and problem solving. On The AI Spectrum, I write about these impacts and how we can create harmony between AI and human thinking.
### Why You Should Trust Me

Don't just take my word for what I write. My blogs are backed by research from influential researchers and organisations. Personally, the numerous studies I have been a part of justify my desire to share my findings with the world.
### I Don't Want You to Stop Using AI

One last clarification: I don't want you to stop using AI. The purpose of my blogs is to raise awareness and provide strategies to preserve your critical thinking. I do not want you to completely abandon AI, as it has great potential when used properly.

founders.name: Aditya Gupta
founders.line: Finding useful tools without losing human judgment.
bio: ## Hi! I’m Aditya Gupta
### Who I Am

I am an expert in the research analysis of AI models while also being the founder of "Produce", my very own AI productivity startup. The partnership between user prompts and AI responses shows how artificial intelligence mimics human thought patterns, offering a unique window into synthetic cognition. As a research analyst, observing how the system tracks context and builds connections has shifted my focus from basic system outputs to the mechanics of artificial reasoning.
### My Journey

After my college application came back to me in the mail, I was disappointed to learn that I had not gotten my desired subject stream. I got accepted into universities such as Stanford and John Hopkins, but MIT always stood out to me. So even though I got AI research instead of aerospace engineering, I went for it. For the first 2 years I hated the entire subject, but after we did a project in which we had to make our own AI model, I fell in love with the entire stream. Nearing the end of my years at MIT, I noticed that people had slowly started to blame AI for making bad content even when the problem lay in the user himself. This question slowly pushed me to make my own AI productivity app "Produce" and eventually co-found "The AI Spectrum".
### What I Found

During the process of building my app and researching the best ways to use AI in 2026, I came across results that I believe no one else has found yet. Since I am not a guy who believes in gatekeeping, I started sharing my findings with others and slowly found a group of people all of whom had something to share with the world in respect to AI. That is when we all came together and founded "The AI Spectrum", a website which uncovers technical answers about AI in the most simplistic manner possible.
### Why You Should Trust Me

I am a professional AI research analyst currently working for Google DeepMind. I cleared MIT alongside the batch of ’22 and went on to do a PhD at Stanford in ’23. Since then, I have switched between multiple well-known organizations such as Nvidia, OpenAI, and Anthropic. So I have my fair bit of experience in this field.
